pictures.deviceText: Kwenziwa lapha, ngasese futhi mahhala, ngisho ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ngasinye sihlolwa lapha kuqala: izithombe ezibonisa ubunqunu, ucansi noma ukuzilimaza ziyenqatshwa.
pictures.suggestiveText: Izingubo zokubhukuda nezangaphansi ezincane, nokuma okuvusa inkanuko. Ubunqunu nocansi kuhlala kwenqatshwa.
pictures.hateText: Izimpawu nenkulumo-ze yamaNazi, yamaphekula neminye yabaqinile. Kuvale ngomlando, ukufundisa noma ukubika izindaba.
pictures.violenceText: Igazi, ukucwiywa, ukulimala okukhulu nezidumbu. Izimpi nokulwa ngaphandle kwalokho kuvunyelwe.
pictures.sd-turbo.text: Izithombe eziyisikwele ngemizuzwana embalwa, ze-SD-Turbo ye-Stability AI, ngaphansi kwelayisensi yayo yomphakathi.
pictures.flux2-klein.text: Izithombe ezicolisekile zanoma yisiphi isimo, cishe ngomzuzu, ze-FLUX.2 [klein] ye-Black Forest Labs, ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-Apache 2.0. Iyona kuphela ekwazi nokushintsha isithombe sakho. Idinga ikhompyutha entsha enenkumbulo eyi-16 GB.
pictures.z-image-turbo.text: Izithombe ezicoliseke kakhulu zanoma yisiphi isimo, namagama akuzo apelwe kahle, cishe ngesigamu somzuzu, ze-Z-Image-Turbo ye-Alibaba, ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-Apache 2.0. Idinga ikhompyutha entsha enenkumbulo eyi-16 GB.
pictures.fastwan.text: Amafilimu emizuzwana emihlanu anoma yisiphi isimo ngencazelo, ngemizuzu embalwa, e-FastWan 2.2 ye-FastVideo, ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-Apache 2.0. Idinga ikhompyutha entsha enenkumbulo eyi-16 GB.
